_readme: Tests skipped by tools/run_all_tests.mjs on PRs. Every entry needs a reason; remove it once fixed or deleted. Nightly runs everything with --all, so quarantined tests stay visible there.

node.tests/renderer_draw_canvas_orchestration: Compares against the stale tracked dist/ mirror; fails on main.
node.tests/startup_resource_graph_contract.te: Defaults to the stale tracked dist/ manifest when no fresh Pages artifact is supplied.
node.tests/state_writer_policy_manifest_behav: Refuses to run outside the dedicated P4 state-writer-policy runner.

python.tests/test_state_write_guardrail_contrac: Shells out to the full state-writer policy checker; did not finish within 43 minutes locally.
python.tests/test_global_transport_builder_cont: Four methods grep transport runtime JS text; rotted.
python.tests/test_data_manifest_contract.py: data/manifest.json hashes for locales.json and runtime_asset_registry.json are stale.
python.tests/test_source_ledger_contract.py: natural_earth_10m_urban_areas_zip ledger entry lacks required checker fields.
python.tests/test_political_topology_gap_contra: Reads published political chunks as GeoJSON; they are TopoJSON now.
python.tests/test_tno_eastern_precision_sources: Expects the plain runtime topology; it is gzip-only now.
python.tests/test_tno_inspector_groups.py: Expects the retired TNO SOV tag (see tools/retire_tno_sov.py).

pythonSlow._reason: Each takes more than about 10 s on a fast workstation (roughly 2x on a 4-core CI runner); nightly runs them.

nodeSlow._reason: Single tests take 15-55 s on a fast workstation (roughly 2x on CI); nightly runs them.

nodeWindowsOnly._reason: Exercises the Windows-only Williams crossover harness (WMI telemetry, power lifecycle, Windows Job runner); runs only on win32.
